@ZMZ91 

Thanks for posting this issue.
As @Neumann-A pointed above, please check the build type and provide the error info.

BTW, you can use this to find `simdjson`.
```
find_package(simdjson CONFIG REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE simdjson::simdjson)
```

Hi @ZMZ91 
Does this issue still exist on your local now?
Please let me know if you have any other questions about this.

Thank you @NancyLi1013 and @Neumann-A for the responses. When I use following to find simdjson
```cmake
find_package(simdjson CONFIG REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE simdjson::simdjson)
```
It failed when set CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE to debug, but succeeded when set CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE to release.
So I really doubt that the lib under debug is not available. And is there any way that vcpkg controls using different CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE for a specific package? Cause you know it may be not a good solution to apply CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=release on a whole project during developing.
